items.question: Where and to what depth must the collected human skull be placed for this rite?
premises: The collected skull is to be placed after being obtained.
The placement is on the ground to the measure of half an arm.
The placement occurs in a forest or wooded area.
items.inference: The ritual requires depositing the collected human skull in the ground at half-arm depth within a forest setting.
uncertainties: Whether kānane and vane denote distinct locations or form a synonymous pair is unclear.
items.plain_english: Having placed it on the ground to the depth of half an arm, in a forest, in a wood.
